risks.title: Dependence on conflict minerals in the supply chain
risks.score_rationale: Risk described in detail in the CMR (Conflict Minerals Report), with cautious language ('unable to verify', 'information provided is often incomplete or not verified'). Trend stable: RMAP compliance rate slightly down (64% in 2023 vs 65% in 2022). High-weight regulatory category for a U.S.-listed industrial company subject to SEC conflict minerals rule.

risks.title: Opacity and complexity of multi-tier supply chain
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly states that ABB is 'several steps removed from smelters/refiners' and 'unable to exert direct influence', representing a structural operational risk. Trend stable, inherent to ABB's industrial model. Number of identified smelters increased (374 in 2023 vs 345 in 2022), indicating growing complexity.

risks.title: Geographic concentration of smelters in China and high-risk regions
risks.score_rationale: Annex I lists reveal heavy concentration of smelters in China (gold, tantalum, tin, tungsten) and in geopolitically risky countries (Russia, DRC, Myanmar). Language implicitly concerning via 'Other smelters/refiners' non-compliant category. Trend upward due to U.S.-China geopolitical tensions and sanctions.

risks.title: SEC regulatory non-compliance on conflict minerals
risks.score_rationale: ABB explicitly states it has not concluded on the 'DRC conflict free' status of its products, relying on the 2014 Court of Appeals decision. This positioning exposes ABB to regulatory risk if the SEC tightens its stance. Trend stable but potentially rising with evolving U.S. regulatory framework.

risks.title: Reputational risk linked to minerals funding armed conflicts
risks.score_rationale: The document acknowledges inability to verify absence of funding to armed groups across the entire chain. Presence of 'Other' (unaudited) smelters in high-risk countries (DRC, Myanmar, Russia) creates tangible reputational risk. Trend stable, but amplified by increasing ESG investor sensitivity.

risks.title: Supplier dependency and low audit response rate
risks.score_rationale: Supplier response rate was 87% in 2023 (down from 90% in 2022), indicating declining supplier engagement. The document mentions 'escalations' required for non-respondents. Moderate compliance risk, slightly increasing.

risks.title: Environmental risk from irresponsible mining practices
risks.score_rationale: Presence of non-RMAP-compliant smelters (122 in 2023) in countries with weak environmental governance (Indonesia, DRC, Myanmar) indirectly exposes ABB to environmental risks. Trend stable, but growth in 'Other' smelters (+10 year-on-year). Moderate weight in current ESG context.

ai_positioning.summary: ABB is gradually integrating artificial intelligence into its automation and predictive maintenance solutions, without making it a central pillar of its communication. AI is used to optimize equipment performance and enhance cybersecurity.
